checkpoint.title: Fuchsia to Cinnabar: Fly to Pallet Town, Surf down Route 21, ashore to the Mansion door

events.why: from the nurse straight south 5 to the Center's door warp (7, 9), held until the warp: the door is the position fix, so no walk to a wall corner first (user, 2026-11-13: the old way west to (0, 5) turned east beside the escalator, whose rail hides the player's legs and the facing read failed); out onto Fuchsia City, where Fly works
the Pidgey (Fly, 10.01), found in the party by its summary's species, flies to Pallet Town, landing below the player's house door (6, 7) (pokeguy 1:18:59, from Fuchsia)

south through the town to the shore (7..10, 17..19), a tile above its east column, facing it: the hold south ends at the water there, and column 10 is the one way down Route21_North clear of its rocks to the sand bar (pokeguy bikes to Pallet's water edge, 1:19:00)

a Repel at the shore before the Surf: Route 21's water has wild Tentacool and Tentacruel on every tile (pokeguy uses one at Pallet Town before surfing to Cinnabar, user's check of the video 2026-11-12); one of 07.01's 5 Repels, which nothing else uses
the lead's Surf (taught in 12.01): A at the water, YES, onto (10, 17)

south down column 10 until the player lands on Route21_North's sand bar (4..10, 27..32) at (10, 28), and on to its south bank (10, 31), where the water stops a player on foot, then over the sand to its bottom row's west end (7, 32), above the water west of Swimmer Spencer's line: one hold that lands and ends at a wall, so it finds the player again (user's design 2026-11-13: surf until landed, walk to the bank, Surf again; console B 06:55 and 07:02, an open leg on the water stopped by a message couldn't be placed). Columns 7 to 9 meet rocks: on 08:51 the hold down column 8 stopped at the rock at (8, 16), which the map had as water (PokemonSimulation #96)

south down column 7 to the rock at (7, 39). Column 10, the old way south, crosses Swimmer Spencer's line: he goes round (8..16, 42..46) and looks a tile ahead (pokefirered walk sequence from (12, 44), range 4 by 2), and on console B 2026-11-13 10:07 he stopped the player after a wild Tentacool

east along row 38 to the wall at (20, 38), above Spencer's line (rows 41 to 47), then south down column 20, east of it (he sees up to column 17), over the connection to Route21_South's rock at (20, 4)

west along row 3 to the wall at (5, 3), a tile back east onto column 6, which has no wall of its own up there (a tile can't stop part-way, so it needs none: 12.03 run 7, console B 2026-11-13 13:31, went south 5, west 1, north 3 and east 2 round the rocks to a wall on column 6 instead), then down column 6 until the player lands on the middle sand bar (5..11, 21..25) at (6, 21), and over it to its south bank (7, 25): column 6 and the bank are out of Swimmer Roland's sight (he wanders (8..12, 27..31) and sees 4 tiles each way) and Swimmer Jack's ((15, 24) looks 3 tiles along row 24); the small sand bar (7..11, 7..10) is passed, since column 10 down to it crosses Swimmer Spencer's line

south down column 7 to the rock at (7, 33), a tile east, then on to the south sand bar (6..11, 36..39) and its south bank (8, 39). Swimmer Roland wanders (8..12, 27..31) and sees 4 tiles each way, across every way from the middle sand bar south: he is fought on this leg, and the leg is planned again from where the battle leaves the player and ends on the bar, so the hold after it lands

south down column 8 until the player lands on the beach (5..13, 48..49) at (8, 48), and on to (8, 49), where Cinnabar Island's wall below stops the player; column 8 keeps off Swimmer Jerome's line ((15, 38) looks 3 tiles west)

east along the beach to its east end (13, 49), where the water stops the player, then a short way south onto the island and east to the wall at (16, 2): a tile long or short, the hold east ends on column 16 all the same (row 3's wall is there too). The way it replaces went south 6 to (13, 5) and east along row 5, a tile above the woman who wanders (13..15, 6) (pokefirered CinnabarIsland map.json, object event 0, WANDER_LEFT_AND_RIGHT range 1): on console B 2026-11-13 11:06 the hold south went a tile long to (13, 6), she stood on (14, 6), and the hold east moved nothing

down column 16 to the Center's wall at (16, 7), east of the woman's walk (13..15, 6): a hold to a wall, where an open hold south 3 to row 5 could end on row 4 or 6 and send the hold east after it along the wrong row. The roof's eave hides the player's legs there (turn_to() takes the turn as turned)

from the Center's wall, north 3 and west 8 along row 4 to below the Mansion door (8, 3), clear of (20, 5), the locked Gym door's trigger: the end 13.01 starts from, a place to know the save by. No wall ends a leg on (8, 4): the door between the walls (7, 3) and (9, 3) is the only one, and a hold north there goes in. So the legs from (16, 7), the last tile both of whose row and column a wall fixed, are open, 3 and 8 tiles on dry land with no wild step; a tile off on row 4, 13.01's first press north meets a wall instead of the door

checkpoint: Starts at Fuchsia's nurse, facing her, where 12.02b ends healed. Out of the Center on foot (Fly works outdoors only), Fly to Pallet Town, then Surf (HM03, taught to the lead in 12.01) down Route 21 onto Cinnabar Island: pokeguy's way after Koga (1:18:59 to 1:19:23), with the Mansion (13.01) next and Blaine after it. No Seafoam Islands (user, 2026-11-12, design section 12). Route 21 is two maps (Route21_North, Route21_South) between Pallet Town and Cinnabar.

Route 21's water has wild encounters (Tentacool, Tentacruel) and its swimmers and tuber see one or four ways a tile or more: the planner keeps off their lines where the water allows. A trainer that does see the player is fought with the normal battle code. No heal at Cinnabar's Center: the lead is healthy enough for the Mansion (user, 2026-11-13).

Ends on Cinnabar Island below the Pokemon Mansion's door, (8, 4) facing north (user, 2026-11-13: a spot to know the save by), from the Center's wall (16, 7), found by two holds to walls (east to column 16, south down it), the first tile after landing whose row and column are both certain, north 3 and west 8. 13.01 starts there and goes in. Not east along row 5: (20, 5), below the Gym's door, is a trigger while the Gym is locked (pokefirered CinnabarIsland coord_events, VAR_TEMP_1 until the SECRET KEY in 13.04): "The door is locked..." and the player is walked a tile south (console B 2026-11-13 13:06, run 6).
